decisions.target_anchor: Keep compliant consumer-specific behavior when the contract is unchanged; change only the surface necessary for the normative delta
decisions.entrypoint_route: For an existing skill (including refactor, split, migration, rename, model upgrade, or deprecation), consult references/lifecycle-and-migration.md before any change; before deleting rules, preserve permissions, safety, exceptions, proof, recovery and DoD via a bounded old→new ledger. Static PASS is BEHAVIOR_NOT_VERIFIED
